title: Evidence hierarchy and authority separation
summary: CivicPort separates immutable source evidence, named mapping results, read-only projections, observations and explicit world-state promotion. A URL, broker, provider, SQL row or Runtime contract is evidence/projection infrastructure and never becomes authority merely by delivering data.
invariants: CivicDocument/CivicQueueDocument retain exact source evidence and provenance before mapping.
Missing and PRESENT_NULL remain distinct; UNKNOWN is not silently converted to known nil.
Mappings are generation-pinned and may fail closed without destroying the source document.
SQL and Runtime Registry are projection surfaces, not network or promotion authorities.
HardWorld promotion is explicit, authority/policy/rule pinned, and can retain conflict rather than overwrite.
procedure: Identify the richest retained source object first.
Define the exact mapping generation separately from parse success.
Add projections only after mapping semantics are explicit.
If promotion is required, use the generic explicit promotion seam and preserve source/provenance identity.

provenance.claim: Evidence hierarchy: document -> mapping -> SQL/Runtime/observation -> explicit promotion.
